## Description

Please include a summary of the changes and the motivation behind them.

Fixes # (issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Refactor / Code cleanliness
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist

- [ ] My code adheres to the repository standards in [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) and [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] **No inline imports**: All `@import` statements are top-level constants.
- [ ] I have added companion tests covering new functionality or bug fixes.
- [ ] All tests pass locally with `zig17 build test` (Zig 0.17+).
- [ ] Code is formatted with `zig fmt`.
- [ ] Module headers and documentation are updated where appropriate.
